title: Best In Class Vortex Flush Is Here
bodyHtml:
New Futura Vortex Flush

Studio Bagno proudly presents Futura — the latest evolution in contemporary bathroomware direct from our Italian manufacturing partner Hatria.

Internationally awarded for design excellence, Futura quietly balances sculptural clarity with intelligent engineering.


Watch Futura's Superior Flush in action here

Multi-Award-Winning Flush Innovation

Recognised with six international accolades — including the Red Dot and German Design Awards — Futura stands as a benchmark in contemporary bathroom design.

Every detail has been considered, from its pared-back silhouette to the discreet front-positioned inlet, creating a piece that feels integrated, intentional, and architecturally resolved.


Internationally Awarded Innovation

Best in class Vortex Flush

At the heart of Futura lies Hatria’s PURE VORTEX system — a powerful, rimless design that uses vortex flow dynamics to achieve an exceptional, near-silent flush without splashing.

Quiet, hygienic, and visually seamless, Futura challenges us to rethink bathroom expectations.

Seamless by Design

With a discreet front-positioned inlet, Futura offers pared-back clarity that integrates seamlessly into any modern bathroom scheme.

It complements the space rather than competes with it — a quiet achiever with bold design credentials.

The Bells and Whistles

Fitted with a premium soft-close, quick-release seat, Futura ensures long life and easy maintenance without compromising aesthetics.

The 4 Star WELS rating reflects its thoughtful balance between water-efficient innovation and uncompromising performance.


Available in Wall Faced and Wall Hung Pan variations

A Colour for Every Vision

Stocked in Gloss White and Matte White, with an extended selection of contemporary made to order gloss and matte hues, Futura offers true freedom of expression while remaining grounded in design discipline.
